lead: A loading placeholder, in three shapes: text, circle and block. There is no width or height prop: to size it, put it in a sized container.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `skeleton.css`: HeroUI uses a shimmer, shadcn and the default style a pulse, and both stop under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
styling.skeleton: The placeholder block; the animation is here
styling.states: Theme styles size it with these; `data-last` marks the last of several lines
